general_information: Research on various factors affecting myocardial infarction outcomes, including hyperglycemia, diabetes, renal function, and medication errors.
Studies on time delays in seeking care for myocardial infarction symptoms and their impact on outcomes.
Investigations into acute coronary care and recommendations for improving care in patients with myocardial infarction.
Guidelines for pre-hospital treatment, emergency medical services, and public education to reduce delays in myocardial infarction treatment.
